name: ping-gateway-route-lab
description: Interactive lab for PingGateway route behaviour with no real PingGateway: a SIMULATED route-condition evaluator, a WWW-Authenticate / RFC 9728 linter, an RFC 7662 introspection stub and a request-to-route table. Mock by default; an opt-in Live mode sends one request to your own loopback gateway and shows its real answer beside the simulator's prediction. Not real PingGateway.

scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
